description_en: Updates the titles, descriptions, tags, and categories of multiple auxiliary media assets in ApsaraVideo VOD based on their IDs. Auxiliary media assets include watermarked images, subtitle files, and other materials
description_zh: 当将带有水印的图片、字幕文件或其它素材等辅助媒体资源上传至视频点播后，可以通过本接口依据这些辅助媒体的唯一标识符（ID），批量更新它们的标题、描述、标签及分类等信息
kebab_example: aliyun vod update-attached-media-infos --update-content '[{"MediaId":"bbc65bba53f6ed90de118a7849****","Title":"标题1","Description":"描述1","Tags":"标签1,标签2"},{"MediaId":"f45cf4eba5cb90233389558c39****","Title2":"标题","Description2":"描述","Tags":"标签3,标签4"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAttachedMediaInfos

parameters.example: [{"MediaId":"bbc65bba53f6ed90de118a7849****","Title":"标题1","Description":"描述1","Tags":"标签1,标签2"},{"MediaId":"f45cf4eba5cb90233389558c39****","Title2":"标题","Description2":"描述","Tags":"标签3,标签4"}]
parameters.help_en:
The update content. You can update the information of up to 20 auxiliary media assets at a time. For the parameter structure, refer to the UpdateContent table below.
The update content for `Title`, `Description`, and `Tags` cannot contain emojis.
If a parameter is passed, the corresponding field is updated. Otherwise, the field is not overwritten or updated
parameters.help_zh:
更新内容。一次最多支持修改20个辅助媒资信息。参数结构请参考下表更新内容UpdateContent。
`Title`、`Description`、`Tags`更新内容中不能包含表情符。
传入参数则更新相应字段，否则相应字段不会被覆盖或更新
parameters.name: update_content
